name: Dorande
description: Dorande was the homeworld of the Dorande race, who tried to conquer the planet R-Duba. This plan was foiled by C-3PO and R2-D2, however.
lead_paragraphs: Dorande was the homeworld of the Dorande race, who tried to conquer the planet R-Duba. This plan was foiled by C-3PO and R2-D2, however.
It was located in the Outer Rim Territories.
